All treat, no trick: HBO Max has released a surprise episode of It: Welcome to Derry for Halloween.
“IT’s a surprise Halloween treat,” HBO Max posted on its Instagram page along with a brief clip of the episode (watch it below). “Catch this never-before-seen special exploring the origins of IT in Derry.”
The episode, “ A Story of Derry ,” is currently streaming on HBO Max.
Earlier this month, showrunner Brad Caleb Kane told Deadline that Season 2 of It: Welcome to Derry – expected to arrive in late 2027 or 2028 – will give fans a new version of Pennywise, with the evil clown (Bill Skarsgård) depicted in a “way you’ve never seen that character before.” Related Stories News Brad Caleb Kane Teases 'It: Welcome to Derry' Is "Bigger" In Season 2 With "A Different Kind Of Pennywise" Cancellations and Renewals 'It: Welcome To Derry' Renewed For Season 2 By HBO; Brad Caleb Kane Now Sole Showrunner
Brad Caleb Kane Teases 'It: Welcome to Derry' Is "Bigger" In Season 2 With "A Different Kind Of Pennywise"
'It: Welcome To Derry' Renewed For Season 2 By HBO; Brad Caleb Kane Now Sole Showrunner
“We’re writing the scripts. We’re about halfway through the writing of the scripts,” said Kane. “We have a production schedule, we’re greenlit for a Season 2, and Andy Muschietti’s out there casting.” Watch on Deadline
Season 2 will be set during the Great Depression in 1935, and revolve around the bloody massacre of the Bradley Gang, a group of bank robbers who stop in Derry to buy ammo and end up facing unimaginable horror, another piece of town history depicted in King’s 1986 novel.
The surprise 30-minute Halloween episode’s logline: “Hundreds of years before Pennywise, three youngsters venture into the Western Wood … where they encounter a terrifying ancient spirit.” The Instagram clip depicts a Native American girl running through the woods, bow and arrow at the ready.
It: Welcome to Derry premiered on HBO Max on Oct. 26, 2025, and serves as a prequel to the 2017 and 2019 films.
